about: Generated by tools/design_system.py build. Do not edit.

components.name: Icon
components.subtitle: 24 line-art spots in list rows
components.summary: Icon is a small line icon of one piece of water-system equipment, a document or a task, painted with a colour token, that lets a list row be recognised before it is read.

components.name: Illustration
components.subtitle: Equipment line art painted with a token
components.summary: Illustration shows an isometric line drawing of Aquemi equipment, painted with a colour token so the same file works in light and dark themes.

components.name: Page
components.subtitle: Section, container and type classes
components.summary: Page is the layout every Aquemi page, section and preview sits in: the container, the section rhythm and the type classes.

components.name: Placeholder
components.subtitle: Highlighted and clean
components.summary: Placeholder marks a fact only Aquemi can supply (a capacity, lead time, certificate, location, case-study figure) so an invented number never ships.

components.name: SplitSection
components.subtitle: Heading column left, content right
components.summary: SplitSection puts a section's heading in a sticky left column and its content on the right, so long pages alternate between full-width and two-column rhythm instead of stacking heading, text, heading, text.

components.name: Spot
components.subtitle: Equipment vignettes at 96, 128 and 160 px, in ink and ink-muted, on surface and on a plate
components.summary: Spot draws one icon from the Icon set larger, as the figure for a stop on a route, a stage of a process diagram, an option module or a zone of a plant map.

components.name: Button
components.subtitle: Primary, secondary, link and disabled; a call whose number is still a placeholder
components.summary: Buttons start an action or move someone to the next step of an enquiry.

components.name: BackToTop
components.subtitle: Floating button, shown once the reader is well down a page; arrow only on phones
components.summary: BackToTop is a quiet floating button that returns the reader to the top of a long page once they are well down it.

components.name: Footer
components.subtitle: Site footer on navy: Limestone logo, description and contact line, four sitemap columns, legal line
components.summary: Footer closes every page on navy: the Limestone logo with one line of description and the contact line, four sitemap columns, and the legal line.

components.name: NavBar
components.subtitle: Desktop header with the service link; phone menu with the urgent block and section jump
components.summary: The site header: logo, primary sections, a "Service request" link and one call to action.

components.name: SectionNav
components.subtitle: Numbered jump links and page progress on a system page
components.summary: SectionNav is a sticky bar of numbered jump links to the sections of a long technical page, with a quiet page progress readout.

components.name: Band
components.subtitle: Statement band on limestone, and on sunken with an optional mark
components.summary: Band sets one short statement large on a quiet limestone or sunken ground, with a supporting line and a faint pipework line drawing at the right; its ground modifiers (`aq-band--limestone`, `aq-band--sunken`, `aq-band--navy`) also change the ground for other sections.

components.name: CaseStudy
components.subtitle: Fact rows and outcome figure; second awaits its figure; third is a template with status, profile and method; fourth is a project record (drawing, outcomes, timeline)
components.summary: CaseStudy summarizes a delivered project as hairline fact rows (client, problem, system delivered) beside one large measured-outcome figure on a quiet panel.

components.name: Closing
components.subtitle: Closing band: centred h1 on navy with the faded lockup, Limestone button; the exchange below a hairline
components.summary: Closing is the call to action at the end of every page: one centred headline in the `h1` style on the navy band, one lead sentence and the primary button, with the lockup (mark and wordmark) faint in the top-left corner.

components.name: ContactRoutes
components.subtitle: Three ways in as rows on hairlines: proposal (this page), urgent service on limestone with its call line, shop visit; each with a 1-2-3 strip and a response clock
components.summary: ContactRoutes sets the ways into Aquemi as rows on hairlines, each with its own numbered 1 → 2 → 3 strip and response clock, so a visitor on a contact page sees which route fits before the form: request a proposal, production stopped (call the service line), or visit the shop.

components.name: DocList
components.subtitle: Documents as a hairline list: code in mono, name, detail; key documents first, code in flow; one link to the full index
components.summary: DocList shows the documents delivered with a system as a quiet hairline list: each row gives the short code a validation team files the document under, its name and one line of detail, with the deciding documents first and their code in `flow`.

components.name: EvidenceMap
components.subtitle: Requirement, how we meet it, file chips or clause references
components.summary: EvidenceMap maps each requirement or standard to how we meet it and the documents that prove it, drawn as a mapping with leader lines and file-shaped chips, for the validation lead asking "where is the proof?".

components.name: Explainer
components.subtitle: One idea as a token-drawn figure plus numbered callouts: endotoxin margin
components.summary: Explainer sets out one idea as a figure plus three or four short numbered callouts instead of paragraphs, for a mechanism a reader should see at a glance (endotoxin margin set by the feed, what an upgrade costs in requalification).

components.name: FAQ
components.subtitle: Hairline accordion rows, second one open with its one link
components.summary: FAQ answers the questions engineers and QA ask before they call, as hairline accordion rows: index, question and a + sign, with the answer opening under the question.

components.name: FaultList
components.subtitle: Failure modes that open to cause and design control
components.summary: FaultList lists where things fail and what we design against; each failure opens to its cause and the design control.

components.name: GradeLanes
components.subtitle: Minimum water grade by step, on three lanes
components.summary: GradeLanes shows the minimum water grade step by step: each step drops a tap into one of three lanes, Potable, PW and WFI.

components.name: Hero
components.subtitle: Five heroes: home loop drawing, hub index, system equipment drawing, drawn binder and drawn route figures
components.summary: Hero opens every page: eyebrow, one display headline, one lead sentence, one primary button and one link.

components.name: LinkGrid
components.subtitle: Six services as linked rows: index, title, one line, standard tag, drawing
components.summary: LinkGrid sets out a list of choices (services, industries, systems, upgrade types) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, title with an arrow when it links, one line, an optional standard tag, and the linked page's icon at the row end on desktop.

components.name: NotesRegister
components.subtitle: Planned notes as a revision register, filtered by topic
components.summary: NotesRegister lists technical notes as a register table: date, note number, topic, title and standard, with topic filter chips and the latest or next planned note in a quiet panel beside it.

components.name: OptionList
components.subtitle: Options as hairline rows; decisions with a ? and a fork mark, one linked to the page that holds it
components.summary: OptionList shows the configuration choices for a system as rows of the shared list grammar: index, option name and one line on what it does.

components.name: OptionModules
components.subtitle: System options as modules wired to the base skid drawing
components.summary: OptionModules draws a system's equipment options as modules around the page's own equipment drawing (the base skid), each wired to it by a dashed hairline; it is the `as: "modules"` shape of the options block (OptionList).

components.name: ParameterCallouts
components.subtitle: Skid design parameters called out on the equipment drawing, the rest folded below
components.summary: ParameterCallouts lays a system's design parameters on its own equipment drawing, with leader lines from numbered labels to the part each one is about.

components.name: ProcessDiagram
components.subtitle: PW skid treatment train as an line-art piping flow: stations are toggles, the pipe tints up to the selected one and its detail opens
components.summary: ProcessDiagram draws a treatment train as an interactive piping flow in single-weight line art: each stage is a station with its equipment vignette, joined by one double-hairline `flow` pipe with arrows, and choosing a station tints the pipe up to it and opens that stage's detail.

components.name: ProcessSteps
components.subtitle: Steps as numbered rows (a row may link to the page that holds that step), or a line-art hold flow
components.summary: ProcessSteps shows a real sequence (a project, a qualification, a service visit) as rows of the shared list grammar: index, step name and what happens.

components.name: Prose
components.subtitle: Heading left; a large light lead, then the paragraphs
components.summary: Prose is running text in a SplitSection: the heading on the left, the first sentence as a large light lead, then the paragraphs in body size, with white space and nothing else around them.

components.name: Readout
components.subtitle: One limit as the page's highlighted figure: the WFI endotoxin limit from the home page
components.summary: Readout sets the page's one highlighted figure: the number large in Geist Mono Light in `flow` with its unit, the method on a limit tag, and a short caption.

components.name: RelatedLinks
components.subtitle: Four pages to read next: index, thumbnail, section eyebrow and title
components.summary: RelatedLinks closes a page with the pages to read next as hairline-topped links: an index, a thumbnail of the target page, its section as an eyebrow and its title with a `flow` arrow.

components.name: RoleMatrix
components.subtitle: Who writes and who reviews, as signature stamps
components.summary: RoleMatrix shows who writes, does and approves each document, like the signature blocks on a controlled document, so the split between our work and your sign-off is visible at a glance.

components.name: Router
components.subtitle: Pick your situation, see one route; pending stations dashed
components.summary: Router lets a buyer pick the situation they are in and see one route through what follows: the water they need, the system, and where to start with us.

components.name: StandardsGrid
components.subtitle: The twelve standards on the home page, code only, on hairlines
components.summary: StandardsGrid lists the standards Aquemi designs to as a numbered three-column grid on `line` hairlines, as a section of its own under a large headline.

components.name: StandardsMap
components.subtitle: Zones of the water system on one pipe, each labelled with the standards that govern it
components.summary: StandardsMap is a plant map of the water system: each zone (generation, storage and distribution, pure steam, controls and data, fabrication, qualification) is a hairline-framed area labelled with the standards that govern it, and every code jumps to the row further down the page that proves it.

components.name: Versus
components.subtitle: Two routes across a spine of factors, with a verdict or a conclusion band
components.summary: Versus sets two routes face to face across a spine of factors, for a buyer choosing one of two (hot or ambient WFI, multi-effect or vapour compression).

components.name: VisitRoute
components.subtitle: A preventive maintenance visit as numbered stops on one route, ending in sign-off
components.summary: VisitRoute lays a visit's checks out as numbered stops on one route line drawn on a Plate, each stop a line drawing of the equipment it covers, for a walk-round whose order matters, such as what a preventive maintenance visit covers, ending at the sign-off.

components.name: WaterPath
components.subtitle: Seven system families as stations on one pipe; the selected family opens its line, standard and link
components.summary: WaterPath shows the system families as stations on one pipe, from city feed to point of use, so the reader sees how the systems connect and can open each one's line, standard and page from the drawing.

components.name: CompareTable
components.subtitle: Start from your water grade: four grades against standard and limits, with a link column
components.summary: CompareTable sets three or more options against criteria as a hairline matrix, with sentence-case column heads on `surface-sunken`, numbered row labels in a narrow left column and, on phones, one record per row (or column tabs for wide tables) instead of a sideways scroll.

components.name: KeyFacts
components.subtitle: Aquemi's own figures, each with its unit and basis, as a quiet strip between hairlines (home, sys-storage and contact-service, placeholders until confirmed)
components.summary: KeyFacts is a strip of up to four of Aquemi's own figures, each with its unit and the basis a reader can hold us to, that tells an engineer what a page stands on before they read a word of copy.

components.name: LimitGauges
components.subtitle: Release limits as dials; design rules as threshold bars, a row linking where it is set; two limits two across, the action level named as one
components.summary: LimitGauges shows a block of water or steam quality limits as quiet instrument faces on a plate, one dial per limit, so a reader sees at a glance where each limit sits and which side of it passes.

components.name: PlanTiers
components.subtitle: Service plans side by side: who each suits, price, terms, one action per plan
components.summary: PlanTiers compares service plans in one table on a plate: numbered terms down the left, one column per plan, a "Fits when" row and one action per plan, for a buyer choosing a plan tier.

components.name: SpecTable
components.subtitle: WFI spec sheet with the critical limit as a readout band, and a comparison table
components.summary: Specification sheets present water quality limits as a two-column matrix with the one critical limit pulled out as a full-width band, the most persuasive content Aquemi has.

components.name: StandardTag
components.subtitle: Standards a system is designed to
components.summary: Standard tags name the regulation, pharmacopoeia or engineering code a system is built to.

components.name: EnquiryForm
components.subtitle: A numbered data sheet with its note under the submit; the stepped form's first step, with a note that sends supplier audits to their own form; an application step with a placeholder option chosen and a required upload left empty
components.summary: EnquiryForm lays out a proposal, service or application request as a numbered data sheet on a quiet panel: numbered sections, numbered items and one submit.

components.name: TextField
components.subtitle: Default, with unit, and error
components.summary: Text fields collect enquiry and service-request details.
